description: Scrape public Facebook event details, organizer Upcoming/Past listings, and keyword search with date, category and location filters. No login or cookies required.

category.description: Optional server-side category filter for search queries. Categories are host-set, so some events have none.
category.title: Category

endDate.description: Optional search filter upper bound in YYYY-MM-DD format. Equal to Start date selects one day.
endDate.title: End date

eventUrls.description: Facebook event URLs or IDs, organizer event pages (e.g. https://www.facebook.com/TED/events, /upcoming_hosted_events, /past_hosted_events), or an events search URL. Group event URLs are skipped because they require login.
eventUrls.sectionDescription: Add at least one event/page URL, search query, or search location.
eventUrls.title: Event, organizer or search URLs

includeOccurrences.description: For recurring events, add every occurrence date and URL to the event record. Uses one extra request only when the event is recurring.
includeOccurrences.title: Expand recurring event dates

includePastEvents.description: For organizer pages, fetch the Past collection instead of Upcoming. Ignored for event URLs and search.
includePastEvents.title: Include past events (organizer pages)

locationId.description: Optional Facebook place ID or /places/<id>/ URL for a location filter on search. Facebook's place scope can include nearby cities. Text-to-ID lookup requires login, which this actor does not use.
locationId.title: Location ID (strict)

maxItems.description: Maximum events per organizer listing or search query. A direct event URL always returns its one event.
maxItems.title: Max results per target

monitorMode.description: For organizer pages and searches, output only events not seen by an earlier run for the same target. The first run is a baseline. State is a named Apify store, is actor-wide (not per user), and is shared by all runs of this actor for the same target; clearing it or changing the target re-emits all events.
monitorMode.title: Monitor mode (only new events)

searchLocation.description: City or place text added to each search query (e.g. "Chicago"). This is a keyword hint, not a strict geographic filter; use Location ID for a strict filter.
searchLocation.title: Search location text

searchQueries.description: Keywords for Facebook's public events search (e.g. "music festival", "tech conference"). Each query is paginated up to Max results.
searchQueries.title: Search queries

startDate.description: Optional search filter lower bound in YYYY-MM-DD format (e.g. 2026-12-01). Applies to search queries only.
startDate.title: Start date

title: Facebook Events Scraper
